correctness.rationale: All-length proof via a complete 12-vertex paired de Bruijn graph, exhaustive ten-simple-cycle census, additive cycle-weight decomposition, and matching sharp constructions. The bivariate enumerator follows from a 16-by-16 equal-output pair transfer matrix minus a four-by-four diagonal transfer matrix; exact determinant factors are checked by 17 integer specializations and a degree-at-most-16 polynomial identity argument. Independent direct forward-image enumeration confirms coefficients through n=14. Ring sizes one and two and ordered-pair normalization are explicitly covered.
